failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, program, prompt, permutation-seed, geometry or cap change. This registration pre-authorises no recovery; a root-diagnosed recovery re-registration is a separate act once the cell is flown. A partial manifest is never read.

generation_budget.definition: 1250 = 625 R01C rows x 2, where 2 is the program's OWN per-row contact ceiling (configs/policy/phase-slurp-verify-select-v1.json max_contacts 2 against ONE phase). The EXPECTED spend is exactly 1.0 contact per row -- 625 contacts -- because 'always-run-full-program' walks each phase once; the ceiling carries one contact of headroom and is a BOUND, never a target. Budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

population.decision_population: All 625 rows are the primary population. Report the 420 content-distinct rows, 414 content-distinct rows with all candidates parsed, 205 identical-answer controls, and 225 row-F1-disagreeing rows separately. Preserve the six rows containing nine malformed source samples; flag their canonical empty renderings. Invalid verifier responses fall back to sealed source sample index 0. Do not exclude failures from complete-roster estimates. Position histograms are descriptive, not tests of semantic selection.

purpose: Cell VERIFY-1 (Stage-3 board route F11, the verifier-selection probe; Stage-3 algorithm family inference-time-verification-v1, operator SELECTION). ONE contact per R01C construction row carries that row's OWN speech plus the FIVE sealed ROLL-1 Solver candidate answers for that same row, in a per-row presentation order pinned by the config, with NO delivered-answer anchor and no retrieved knowledge, and asks the frozen core to name the candidate the speech supports under a two-field contract (chosen_position, reason). The question is the ORACLE gap the offline sample-aggregation read measured over this same sealed rollout: +6.55 pp pooled SLU-F1 and +12.55 pp on the 225 score-disagreeing rows, none of which any deterministic agreement rule reached. Does the frozen core VERIFY better than it GENERATES? DESCRIPTIVE: no admission verdict, no comparator arm, no gate, nothing admitted, released or locked.

stage3_algorithm.note: VERIFY-1 is the first cell of this family and exercises the SELECTION operator only: the frozen core reads its OWN five sealed candidate answers for a row and names one, and the delivered artifact is that name. The family's SCORING operator is deliberately NOT claimed -- the cell asks for no per-candidate score, ranking or margin, so nothing in the sealed output can be read as a model-produced score. Nothing in the store, the plan's context or the sampling policy changes; the candidates are the sealed ROLL-1 rollout's own.
